meta.split: GKM429: sha1(id)[0] < 0x33 held out, frozen before scoring

rules.mechanism: Gu rank = median known rank of its band, path and type family (resemblance; PWC83 second voice)
inputs: known ranks of the family (training rows only)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; cohort = rows whose wiki and chapter ranks agree
rules.set: held-out cohort rows the rule applies to
rules.note: Within-band = rank within one. A rule that rests on name resemblance, not on what the Gu does.

rules.mechanism: Gu rank = highest known precursor rank + 1 (refinement process; PWC93)
rules.fit: none (the +1 is a constant, nothing is fitted from training ranks)
inputs: known ranks of the family (training rows only)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; cohort = rows whose wiki and chapter ranks agree
rules.set: whole cohort rows with a precursor edge (nothing fitted, so no hold-out needed); held-out slice is n=9
rules.note: Held-out slice alone is below the floor; the rule fits nothing, so the whole cohort is a fair test.

rules.mechanism: Ordered set: precursor rank + 1, inverse (below its products), next-rank link, story-time neighbours (first appearance), family median fallback (PWC99)
rules.fit: nothing fitted beyond k=7 neighbours, chosen on folds 1-4
rules.split: five frozen folds (gu_rank_folds.json); fold 5 scored once
rules.baselineRule: family-median set on the same fold
rules.set: frozen fold 5, every cohort row (abstain falls back to family median)
rules.note: Proposal, not wired into any builder. Story-time is a narrative proxy, not an in-world process (PWC93).

rules.mechanism: Gu rank climbs by the step a numbered series shows
inputs: known ranks of the family (training rows only)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; cohort = rows whose wiki and chapter ranks agree
rules.set: whole cohort rows in a series
rules.note: Not among the six rules the ledgers cite (it produced no row); scored for completeness.

rules.mechanism: An ingredient carries the property axis of the potions whose recipes use it (recipe edges; PWC93)
rules.fit: axis votes from training siblings; dials in DERIVE_DIALS
rules.split: GKM429, held-out ingredients hide their own stated axes

allHeldOut.note: abstain counted as a miss; the rule alone loses to "always venom" here, the rule with baseline fallback wins

rules.note: Misses are pinned in hp_derived_score.json heldRun.misses.

rules.mechanism: A same-Sequence characteristic can stand in for the potion main (brew_law main slot)
rules.split: GKM429 (frozen in 13b7b765c); labels = Luna recall of the natural main, not a chapter read
rules.set: held-out rows with a determinable natural main, both axes right

baseline.name: majority pathway and Sequence (upper bound: the smaller single-axis majority count)

rules.note: The rule says a characteristic CAN replace a main; it never claimed it is the natural main, so a miss here is partly a mismatch of claim and test (edge case E1).

rules.mechanism: Sequence 0 potion = the pathway Uniqueness plus Sequence 1 characteristics
rules.fit: fitted to the two stated Sequence 0 formulas (Blasphemy Card, Fool 0)
rules.split: none: no Sequence 0 formula is left to hold out
rules.note: Scored, not judged. Needs a later Sequence 0 formula from the books (PWC87).

rules.mechanism: A model drafts a Gu from a concept word and the catalogue prefix; rank band, path and verb checked against canon Gu of the same concept
rules.split: concepts frozen before generation; scored on canon Gu that share the concept
rules.set: rank band, every scored concept (path and verb in note)
rules.note: Ahead of baseline on path (78.6% against 65.8%, n=117), behind on band and verb (49% against 54.8%, n=104). These rows already carry tier generated; no relabel needed, the palette says why.

rules.mechanism: LOTM law applied to CoI: a same-Sequence characteristic stands in for the potion main (PWC97 transfer, no refit)
rules.fit: none (the LOTM law, unchanged; the baseline class is the only fitted value, from the training split)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; the stated set is small, so the whole set is scored and the held-out slice is stored beside it
rules.set: whole stated CoI formula set (held-out slice n=2, 1 of 2 right)
rules.note: Misses are named exceptions in docs/coverage/coi_potions_score.json (PWC92). The rule claims a characteristic CAN stand in; a natural-only row is a sheet or scene that shows the natural mains and no characteristic route, which the rule does not contradict, so the miss is partly claim versus test (LOTM edge case E1).

rules.mechanism: LOTM derived row carries one main slot (the characteristic) for Sequence 9 to 1
rules.fit: none (the LOTM law, unchanged; the baseline class is the only fitted value, from the training split)
rules.split: GKM429 hash split; the stated set is small, so the whole set is scored and the held-out slice is stored beside it
rules.note: The sheets list the natural parts the characteristic fuses (two for most Sequences), so a one-slot row is a different count of the same stuff, not a wrong potion. Named exception X1; the derived rows still carry one characteristic slot, which the novel states is the fusion of the two main ingredients.
